lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Multiple horizontal rows of high-luminance circular spots are visible posterior to the gill slits, with the most distinct clusters arranged in a linear series along the mid-lateral line.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect the primary horizontal rows of blobs, creating a discernible grid-like structure across the mid-flank region.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three prominent longitudinal ridges are visible on the upper flank, characterized by a sharp vertical gradient transition from high-intensity reflectance on the upper edge to shadow on the lower edge.

other_distinctive_markers: The dorsal surface of the pectoral fin displays a dense concentration of high-luminance spots that are significantly smaller and more tightly packed than those on the primary lateral flank.
